purpose_context: The Regnology Agent Stack installer scripts (install-regnology-stack.sh / .ps1) were written but cannot download the doctrine pack because no Artefactory publish pipeline exists yet. This mission closes that gap by adding a pack version file, a Jenkins publish stage that pushes versioned archives on merge to main, and an updated HOW_TO_USE guide that replaces the manual 6-step setup with a single bootstrap command.
purpose_tldr: Publish versioned pack archives to Artefactory and document the bootstrap installer as the primary setup path
